title: git auto-maintenance fixtures prove nothing on Apple git 2.50.1 (TestAnAgentsCommitStartsNoMaintenance, TestTheHarnessStartsNoGitItDoesNotWaitFor)
body: internal/gitbin's and internal/reconcile's maintenance fixtures both fail on this host with 'a plain commit ... started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing' — the control leg of the fixture (a plain commit must START maintenance so the suppressed leg can be compared) does not fire under this machine's Apple git 2.50.1 settings. Reproduced at the base commit, so pre-existing; these are host-dependent tests of the same family the learnings already flag ('a gate verdict is about the tree only if the host is bounded').
